title: Steps to Broadway! Wifi, Pool, Parking Available
description:
Experience the best of Nashville with a stay at this stylish, centrally-located place just 5 minutes walk from Broadway. Enjoy the nightlife, music scene, and cultural attractions of downtown Nashville. 

Walk
4 mins →Country Music Hall of Fame
7 mins →Bridgestone+Broadway Strip
10 mins→The Ryman
20 mins →Titans Stadium

10 min drive→Nashville Airport/BNA

Parking $30 per night

The space
Our space provides three spacious queen beds which easily accommodates 6 guests.

There are two smart TVs. Feel free to login into your favorite streaming platforms.

Enjoy the complimentary coffee, tea, wine, and water!

Other amenities:
→ Self check-in
→ Stunning, spacious common workspaces and lux lounges
→ Plush Queen memory foams mattresses that feels AMAZING !
→ 50” TV

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire unit and all of the property’s amenities such as lobby, courtyard, sky lounge, swimming pool & gym are included in this rental. Please make yourself at home.

Please note, to access the pool, you must list all of your guests’ names for each guest you have in your Airbnb Reservation details. This would be a detail you must update in your reservation.

Other things to note
This property operates with DOOR smart lock system which we will provide you access upon booking.
